Math

There is a little mathematics in everything: the symmetry of a leaf, the rhythm of a pattern, and the shapes we build. This future space will help turn unfamiliar numbers into ideas you can picture.

Planned topics include everyday calculations, fractions, geometry, and step-by-step problem solving. Lessons are still being developed.
